Bangladesh mission in Delhi pays tribute to language martyrs
2023-02-21T20:56:53+06:00 | Star Digital Report
https://www.thedailystar.net/news/bangladesh/news/bangladesh-mission-delhi-pays-tribute-language-martyrs-3253826

The Bangladesh High Commission in New Delhi today paid tributes to the 1952 language martyrs by bringing out a "probhat pheri" and placing wreaths at a Shaheed Minar at the chancery.

The national flag was kept at half-mast and a special prayer was held seeking divine blessings for the martyrs. One minute silence was held in memory of the martyrs, reports our New Delhi correspondent.

The "probhat pheri" was led by High Commissioner Mustafizur Rahman.

The Ekushey elegy "Amar Bhaiyer Rakte Rangano Ekushey February" was sung.

Mustafizur Rahman said, UNESCO declared February 21 as International Mother Language Day in 1999 thanks to efforts made by Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina. He also praised the historic role of Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman to establish Bangla as the state language.
